title: Heavenly Fate Resonance
next_chapter_hook: Just as that sword light was about to tear through the night sky, in the demonic army camp a million li away, a figure who had been sleeping for years suddenly opened his eyes, golden pupils reflecting the same celestial phenomenon.

text.content: The moment that sword light tore through the night curtain, Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Sword Intent Piercing the Void—the ultimate technique only executable by core elders and above in the Tianqing Sect—now arrived with undisguised killing intent. The words "the visitor bears ill will" flashed through his mind, yet his expression remained unmoved. Only his fingertips in his sleeve quietly formed seals. Ye Qing beside him also sensed that fierce sword intent, demonic path mist instinctively surging, but under Chen Ji's glance she suppressed the energy fluctuation. Within the talisman formation, Chen Ji and Ye Qing locked eyes, and at this life-and-death moment, an uncanny tacit understanding emerged between them.

dialogue.content: (Tilted his head slightly, voice pressed extremely low) Arrived half an hour earlier than what the Tianji Record indicated. It seems Ling Yuan, that old fox, couldn't wait to personally clean up the sect.

(Demonic energy slightly gathering, voice equally extremely low) A Tianqing Sect elder personally making a move? This talisman formation was already precarious—if he strikes with full force... both of us will end up here.

text.content: Chen Ji didn't respond. His divine sense swept back and forth between the line of mysterious ancient script and the approaching sword light, his mind rapidly calculating every possible outcome. If he activated the Tianji Record to glimpse the next three hours, he'd need to consume at least five Heavenly Fate Value—his final trump card for survival. The power contained in that sword light was unmistakably a full-force strike from the late Nascent Soul stage. Given the talisman formation's current stability, it wouldn't hold for three breaths. The sword's roar grew ever closer, piercing the ears painfully. Ye Qing's hand had already pressed against the demonic sword at his waist, knuckles faintly white.

choice.prompt: Life-and-death decision: exchange Heavenly Fate Value for crucial intelligence about the future, or seek another path?

choices.text: Consume Heavenly Fate Value for Foresight
choices.description: Forcefully activate the Tianji Record to foresee critical variables in the next three hours, trading intelligence for survival
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Value is the foundation of survival; this expenditure will impact subsequent critical junctures

text.content: A hint of hesitation flickered across Chen Ji's eyes. Heavenly Fate Value—this was his greatest trump card for traversing the world and calculating without error, each point precious beyond measure. Yet in the next instant, he drew a deep breath, his gaze suddenly resolute. Fingers in his sleeve shifted, a secretive technique sinking into his brow. The Tianji Record fragment blazed open within his Mental Sea, golden characters moving like living things, but at the crucial moment they were suppressed by an odd force—Chen Nian's aura, faint yet warm, as if saying: don't use this lightly.

choices.description: Share the talisman formation pressure with Ye Qing through merged spiritual energy, using doubled spiritual power to mend the defensive breach
choices.visible_reward: Trigger Bloodline Resonance, acquire unexpected intelligence
choices.risk_hint: Requires establishing deep spiritual connection with Ye Qing, potentially exposing inner secrets

text.content: Chen Ji's lips curved into a faint smile, carrying an almost serene quality that Ye Qing found striking. "Ye Saint," he said suddenly, his voice steady despite the life-or-death crisis unfolding around them, "will you wager with me?" Before she could respond, he extended his right hand, palm up, spiritual energy threading out like silk, weaving a fragile bridge between them. "If we merge our spiritual energies and support the formation together with doubled strength—even if Ling Yuan arrives in person, he'd have to weigh the backlash of this formation."

choices.description: Hold position, wait for the opponent to reveal weakness first, adapt through stillness
choices.risk_hint: If the opponent's strength is overwhelming, risk missing the optimal response window

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his gaze and, in this critical moment, closed his eyes. His breathing slowed to an elongated, peaceful rhythm, as if the sword light, killing intent, and crisis around him held no relevance. "What's the rush," he murmured to himself, "Ling Yuan, that old fox, comes personally yet only sends a single sword strike to test... what is he afraid of?" This unusual behavior made Ye Qing frown slightly, yet instinctively he restrained his impulse to act, waiting together for the situation to unfold.

"Spiritual energy flowed like a trickle from Chen Ji's palm, intertwining with Ye Qing's demonic power between the two. In that moment, Ye Qing felt an incomparably pure force surge into her meridians—Chen Ji's spiritual energy, pure to an unbelievable degree, as if containing countless intricate calculations, yet at certain moments revealing a chilling edge. She instinctively wanted to resist, but upon touching his calm, water-like gaze, she let down her guard. The two forces slowly merged, the pressure from the formation array instantly diverted, and the flickering light stabilized anew. The sword light howled forth, slamming violently against the formation array, stirring up clouds of spiritual light ripples, yet it was firmly blocked by that thin membrane of light."

dialogue.content: "(Eyes flickering with surprise, whispering) Your spiritual energy... how can it be so pure? To condense it to this degree requires decades of unremitting refinement. Your废物人设 has deceived everyone."

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer her question. The depth of their spiritual energy fusion had far exceeded his expectations, and their spiritual consciousnesses had formed some kind of subtle entanglement at this moment. He could sense the struggle within Ye Qing's heart—that was hatred toward the Holy Sect, a longing for freedom, and a trace of unwillingness to admit vulnerability. This perception was mutual; Ye Qing likewise detected the stubborn determination deep in his heart: Chen Nian's smile, blurry yet warm, the only light guiding him through the darkness. However, just as their spiritual consciousnesses intersected, a strange yet utterly familiar aura surged forth simultaneously from the depths of both their bloodlines.

choice.prompt: Bloodline agitation: suppress this strange sensation, or let it spread through the spiritual consciousness?

choices.description: Proactively open one's guard, letting the pull from the bloodline guide the spiritual consciousness to explore the source of this phenomenon
choices.visible_reward: Unlock a corner of the truth about the bloodline twins
choices.risk_hint: May expose more inner secrets, and this pull may lead the spiritual consciousness to an unknown destination

dialogue.content: "(Eyes flashing, whispering) Interesting... since it's here, why not let it speak clearly?"

choices.description: Immediately cut off the spiritual resonance, using forced methods to block this strange bloodline sensation
choices.visible_reward: Maintain mystery, not expose more trump cards
choices.risk_hint: Forced severance will damage the meridians, and may miss important truths

dialogue.content: "(Eyes suddenly turning cold, spiritual energy contracting sharply) This thing... has an unknown origin, seal it for now."

text.content: Chen Ji chose to open his mind. The pull from deep within his bloodline rushed forth like a tide, instantly pulling his consciousness into an unknown vortex. Ye Qing was similarly carried by this force, and in that moment, the two's consciousness achieved an unprecedented resonance—she witnessed fragments of his memories: Chen Nian's smile as she was taken away by Holy Sect disciples, that wound he could never heal; and he witnessed her fear and loneliness buried beneath the glory of the Demonic Path's Saint, that despair of being used as a tool. Yet just as this resonance peaked, a golden light exploded from where their bloodlines intertwined, pulling both their consciousnesses into an even deeper realm.

It was an endless void. No light, no sound, only two intertwined bloodline forces slowly rotating in the darkness. Chen Ji's consciousness was like a small boat, being pushed toward some unknown shore by that mysterious force. Gradually, he sensed the outline of another existence—that was an incomparably powerful yet bloodline-linked aura, like another self in a mirror, watching him from a commanding height. At the same time, that aura also detected his presence. Within the void, two consciousnesses collided violently, and a blurry scene emerged before Chen Ji's eyes: on a blood-colored battlefield, a man in black-gold battle armor stood with his back to him, and that man's aura... was identical to his yet diametrically opposed.

dialogue.content: "(Pupils shrinking sharply, heart churning with惊天骇浪) This is impossible... this aura... it's of the same source as me?"

text.content: Just as Chen Ji was caught in doubt, the figure in black-gold battle armor slowly turned around. A face seven-tenths similar to Chen Ji's came into view, except for those eyes—they were two balls of burning golden flames, cold, indifferent yet bearing an indescribable pressure. "Tianji Record's host..." that voice was like an ancient bell tolling, echoing through the void, "so it's you." In the next instant, a terrifying suffocating might poured forth from that figure. Chen Ji felt his consciousness gripped by an invisible hand, and a deafening voice rang in his ears: "Remember, bloodline twins share fortune and ruin alike. When this one achieves success, that is when you and I become one." With the words, the figure dissolved into golden light, leaving only a chaotic void and Chen Ji's violently pounding heart.

dialogue.content: "(Eyes snapping open, demonic energy surging wildly, voice trembling) You... you saw it too? That person... that aura... has an inexplicable connection to my Holy Sect!"

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer. His consciousness still trembled in the aftermath of that might, and those words "become one" coiled around his heart like venomous snakes. Bloodline twins—he had never imagined such a bizarre connection existed between himself and that Demonic Path commander. What did this mean? Was he a chosen vessel, or a designed chess piece? The Tianji Record Fragment quivered slightly in his Mental Sea, and Mr. Mo's aged voice sounded at the right moment: "Boy, you've finally touched the edge of fate. Remember, the Eye of Heavenly Way never lets any chess piece off easily—it wants balance, control, eternal chess." Chen Ji took a deep breath, pressing all his shock and doubts into the deepest corner of his heart. When he opened his eyes again, they had regained their usual composure and depth.

Outside the formation array, that sword light had quietly dissipated, as if it had never appeared. Yet Chen Ji knew Ling Yuan's probing would never be so simple—that old fox must be watching from some hidden place, waiting for the perfect moment to strike. But at this moment, his mind was entirely occupied by another thought: that Demonic Path commander, that man connected to him by blood, who was he? Why had the Tianji Record never shown this variable? Just as he pondered, Ye Qing suddenly grabbed his sleeve, pointing toward the distant horizon, her voice carrying an unbelievable tremor: "Look... what is that?" Chen Ji followed her gaze, his pupils tightening sharply—on the distant sky, seven stars were aligned in a bizarre pattern, their light piercing through layers of clouds,直射向他们所在的方向. At the same time, that ancient Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's Mental Sea spontaneously ignited, golden characters reorganizing in the flames, and a never-before-seen name slowly emerged—Demon Sovereign·Heavenly Fate.

dialogue.content: "(Gazing at the seven aligned stars, voice low and calm) Heavenly Fate... so that's how it is. This is the true chess game arranged by the Eye of Heavenly Way—not the Tianji Record, not the Prophet, but a pair of bloodline twins, restraining each other, enabling each other, until one devours the other."

text.content: When Ye Qing heard these words, her face paled considerably. Though she was the Demonic Path's Saint, she had never heard of such a being existing within the Holy Sect. "Heavenly Fate... Demon Sovereign Heavenly Fate..." she murmured the name repeatedly, "no wonder every generation of Holy Sect Saints must cultivate that forbidden technique, no wonder they never let us approach core secrets... so everything was for today!" Her voice carried suppressed fury, her fists clenched tightly, fingernails digging deep into her palms. Chen Ji looked at her and suddenly spoke: "In the Holy Sect, have you ever seen any records about 'twins'?" Ye Qing's head snapped up, a complex light flickering in her eyes: "There is an ancient book under seal, documenting an apocalypse from ancient times—when Heavenly Way split a Heavenly Fate Pact into two halves and implanted them into hosts of different bloodlines. Those two hosts, one controlling Heavenly Secrets, one ruling the Demonic Path, opposing each other yet bound by fate." She paused, voice trembling: "I always thought it was merely legend..."

dialogue.content: (Took a deep breath, gazing at Chen Ji with complex eyes) "So... from the very beginning, you were never an ordinary prophet. You are the other chosen vessel of Heavenly Fate selected by the Heavenly Dao. And that Demon Lord's Heavenly Fate is your destined... enemy? Or—"

text.content: Chen Ji didn't let her finish. His gaze pierced through layers of clouds and mist, falling upon the distant horizon where a figure was slowly rising—the direction of the Demon Path's great camp. Even separated by countless miles, he could sense those golden eyes gazing at him through the Void. The resonance of Heavenly Fate still echoed through his bloodline, a strange sensation, as if his other half soul was attached somewhere distant, waiting to merge with him as one. "Twin fates of destiny..." he murmured softly, a meaningful curve appearing at the corners of his lips. "The Eye of the Heavenly Dao, you have underestimated me far too much. You wanted me to become a chess piece, so I shall be the one who moves the pieces. You wanted me to merge with him..." He paused, a sharp cold light flickering in his eyes. "Then let's see who ultimately gets devoured." As his voice fell, a sinister laugh suddenly echoed from beyond the formation—an old, familiar voice, precisely Ling Yuan: "Chen Ji, Chen Ji, do you think by hiding within this formation, this old man cannot do anything to you? Heavenly Fate Resonance—what a splendid Heavenly Fate Resonance! Let's see whether you can still laugh when you're eventually devoured by that Demon Lord!"
